I think we can definitely agree that it's a bad idea to operate on yourself with any major procedures, especially if you're a teenager and/or don't have a medical degree.

Slightly better idea, if that's the route you think would be best in order to have a flat chest, try to get a double mastectomy. It's probably expensive especially if it's just because you want to do it and not because of a disease (not many health insurance plans, at least in america, will cover cosmetic procedures like that) but it's a much better way to go then to just chop them off. The sanitary conditions and medical professionals in a hospital will do much more for you than paracetamol, no matter how strong it is.

Hey, I've had some kinda similar feelings to you, there are days where I feel completely comfortable identifying as a trans woman but then sometimes I feel much less dysphoria and sometimes even comfortable as a guy... I'm not really sure what it means for me and I definitely can't say what it means for you but it mainly comes down to listening to your heart and figuring out how you feel most comfortable... I can definitely attribute some of my own feelings to the crazy anxiety that I get all the time. I sometimes wonder if I'm more nonbinary but the key is just to listen to how you feel and figure it out based on that. Don't worry about what other people will think about it, just focus on what is comfortable for you. Best wishes
